recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-6096 unless a future work group decision changes Bundle search-entry summary behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-6096 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 Feed/Bundle change request asking that Bundle elements be marked as "in summary" so summary search results would not serialize as empty Bundles, specifically calling out Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry.search, and child elements.
initial_application: Jira comments cite SVN revision 6075 as the application, and the git-svn history contains fa3683b88eb584f9e990707d783194da92ead953 with subject "#6096 - Fix summary for Bundle" and git-svn-id build@6075. Later source refactors moved Bundle into the current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml representation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists bundle=Bundle, so the Bundle source is in current build scope. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later decision reversing or conflicting with the requested Bundle summary behavior.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml already marks Bundle.entry, Bundle.entry.resource, Bundle.entry.search, Bundle.entry.search.mode, and Bundle.entry.search.score with isSummary=true.
